Original Decipher card face for [[Tatooine: Mos Espa]], rotated losslessly from the archive scan [[:File:Tat-L-tatooinemosespa-decipher-archive.jpg]] so the location reads landscape.

Source: [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/images/tatooinemosespaL.jpg tatooinemosespaL.jpg], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010807235100/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/images/tatooinemosespaL.jpg Internet Archive], 7 August 2001. SHA-256 of the archived file: 00efb2a3922142a3386989284b89694c1321a7d5afa7e4a185c4a017695b85bd.

Edits: rotated losslessly from the archive scan (jpegtran -trim -rotate 90 -copy all; JPEG data rotated without recompression). jpegtran drops the partial 8-pixel block at one edge (4 pixel rows of black border); no other change.

The Holotable face [[:File:Tat-L-tatooinemosespa.gif]] is a separate file and is not replaced by this file.

Fair use rationale: this is a low-resolution image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and discuss the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
